text:
Raya: GreenForge wants a marketplace quickstart repo that supports PrivateLink + marketplace listing. Deliverables: Terraform module (privatelink endpoint, optional NLB), minimal IAM, packaging checklist, SBOM, and a 1-page ops runbook. Timeline: 10 days. Who can take lead?
Tom: I can own the Terraform module. Plan a var `enable_privatelink = true` and `network_mode = \"nlb\" | \"alb\"`. Example: ```terraform
module \"greenforge_marketplace\" {
  source = \"github.com/redwood-inference/partner-stencils/greenforge\"
  enable_privatelink = true
  network_mode = \"nlb\"
  region = var.region
}
```
Anika: I'll do packaging and README. Need partner-signed manifest, SBOM, and image provenance steps. Also add a small "how to verify PrivateLink" section with curl examples hitting the private endpoint.
Mina: Ops/CI note: add `ci/marketplace-privatelink.yml` that runs SBOM generation, deploys infra into an ephemeral acct (with PrivateLink configured), runs `scripts/verify_privatelink.sh` which validates DNS, TLS, and a sample generation check, then tears down. I'll stub the GH action.
Tom: For IAM keep it minimal: a role for deploy that grants Describe/Attach ENI, Create/Describe VPC endpoints, and read-only S3 for model artifacts. Add a `security.tf` snippet in the module with strict defaults.
Anika: We'll include `examples/privatelink-client` with a Python snippet showing how to resolve the private DNS and call the endpoint. Also include a small prompt set (5 prompts) for sanity checks.
Raya: GreenForge confirmed they will provide signed OCI images and a weekly CVE report. They asked for a short Redwood performance blurb (non-prod numbers only) for the marketplace listing. Use our perf docs link and mark it as lab numbers.
partner-catalog-bot: Created ticket P-4120: "GreenForge PrivateLink marketplace quickstart + Terraform module" assigned to @Tom and linked to partner-catalog epic.
Tom: I'll open a skeleton PR with module scaffolding and defaults by Tue. Can someone volunteer to review the README and the ops runbook before PR merge?
Mina: I'll review the CI workflow and smoke scripts Thursday 2pm PT.
Anika: I'll draft the README and runbook, pinging for review Wed afternoon.
Raya: Thanks team 44d let's do a quick sync Friday 10am PT to confirm PR status and perf blurb wording.
